title: Step 2 · Change order · raised to released · 18.6 s
sub: CC-2148 on one record: it arrives with its reason from NC-204, AI names what else it affects and a person adds it, production confirms, quality signs under Part 11, and it can only be released with the approvals in.

beats.head: Raised (the poster)
beats.text: CC-2148, torque spec update, raised from NC-204 with the root cause linked. In review, 0 of 8, Release change locked.

beats.head: The drawing lands
beats.text: S. Okafor: housing fastener torque goes from 4.2 to 4.8 N·m. DWG-2201 Rev D and the risk assessment attached.

beats.head: Reason and documents tick themselves
beats.text: Reason for change from NC-204, affected documents SOP-118 and DWG-2201 from the drawing. 2 of 8.

beats.head: What else does this change affect?
beats.text: D. Fontaine, the owner, hovers the AI button in the checklist: What else does this change affect? (Beta).

beats.head: It reads the change
beats.text: Pressed, the button works on the reason and the impact answers.

beats.head: The suggestion, as the product posts it
beats.text: Her message in the thread: asked AI suggestion for Assess impacted documents. Field label / Suggested Value, one box per row, Add to Checklist greyed.

beats.head: A person decides
beats.text: She ticks AI impact summary; Add to Checklist wakes.

beats.head: Added to Checklist
beats.text: Nothing lands on the record until she adds it.

beats.head: The records land
beats.text: AI impact summary written; WI-092 and FRM-201 linked as document records, suggested by AI, added by D. Fontaine. 4 of 8.

beats.head: On to the approvals
beats.text: The checklist scrolls to Approvals and Closure.

beats.head: Production confirms
beats.text: M. Kerr: Line 2 can run the new torque from Monday's first shift. Production readiness ticks live. 5 of 8.

beats.head: Sign, on the checklist
beats.text: She presses Sign on Quality approval, as on the platform film.

beats.head: The Part 11 dialog
beats.text: Meaning of signature: Approval, I approve this change as written.

beats.head: Her credentials
beats.text: User ID dfontaine, password typed. Name, meaning and time kept on the record.

beats.head: Signed
beats.text: Sign, Signing, Signed.

beats.head: Sealed on both sides
beats.text: Signed on Quality approval (Approval · 09:21) and her signature card in the thread. 6 of 8.

beats.head: Release unlocks
beats.text: Only with the approvals in does Release change unlock.

beats.head: She releases it
beats.text: Hover, press, Releasing.

beats.head: Released
beats.text: Status Released. Revision: DWG-2201 Rev D effective. Training assigned to Line 2 operators, due Oct 2. 8 of 8. The thread records it.

beats.head: End at rest
beats.text: The released change. The page holds this 1.5 s, then the next tab starts.
